messages:
Maya (PR): Quick sync — launch date locked for 2027-05-12. We need to finalize press + analyst outreach cadence by EOD Thurs. Embargo target: 09:00 PT. Who owns the quote approvals?
Ethan (Growth): I can own routing for press contacts and the calendar slots. Will need the final quote by Tue COB.
Lena (Product): Benchmarks narrative ready for review. Shared the draft here: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-release/benchmarks/runner-v1.md — want PR to sanity-check phrasing around cost per token vs latency.
Tom (Engineering): Heads up — we might tweak throughput numbers after last perf run. ETA for final numbers: Mon morning.
Maya (PR): @Noah can Legal sign off on the quote language and embargo terms? Also need a 24hr fact-check window post-embargo for analysts.
Noah (Legal): Yes, send the quote draft. Legal prefers conservative phrasing — avoid absolutes like "always" and "zero". We need a signed fact-check NDA for any pre-embargo deep dives.
Sofia (Sales): For inbound routing: can we add a quick routing note in the press kit for sales handoff? Example: "Lead tier: press -> SDRs for immediate follow, analysts -> AE. Add lead tag: press-2027-launch."
Maya (PR): Good call. I'll add routing snippet to press kit. Press kit live: s3://redwood-release/presskit-2027-05-12/ (contains one-pager, benchmarks, quote templates).
Ethan (Growth): Scheduling note: prefer short 20-min analyst walk-throughs. We have limited analyst availability in APAC — can we offer EOD PT and a 08:00 APAC slot?
Lena (Product): Yes, we'll prepare a condensed demo + two benchmark slides for the 20-min slot.
Tom (Engineering): FYI: if we change the perf table, update the CSV in the kit too: s3://redwood-release/benchmarks/data.csv.
Maya (PR): Quote template (draft) below — please paste edits inline in the doc:
```
"Redwood Inference enables predictable, low-latency LLM serving at scale. In our benchmarks we observed median token latency of ~X ms and cost improvements of ~Y% versus baseline."
```
Maya (PR): Whoever finalizes quote, ping @Noah before sending.
Noah (Legal): Roger. Also put a short boilerplate: "Results may vary by workload and configuration." I will sign off on that.
Ethan (Growth): Calendar poll: https://doodle.com/poll/launch-analyst-slots — please vote by Tue noon. I'll lock the briefing schedule Wed morning.
press-bot: Calendar invites created for slots confirmed on Wed 10:00 PT and Thu 16:00 CET.
Sofia (Sales): For inbound playbook: suggest a 3-step triage — 1) tag and route, 2) send press kit + quick follow, 3) AE outreach if analyst expresses MQL intent. I can draft a short playbook doc by Wed.
Lena (Product): Quick decision: include the 99th percentile latency in the public benchmarks? It might fluctuate. If we include it, add a footnote with sequence length and batch settings.
Maya (PR): Let's include p99 with footnote. Transparency helps with analysts. Add the footnote text to the kit.
Tom (Engineering): I'll freeze the perf figures Mon 09:00 PT. Once frozen, I'll push the CSV and update the S3 path.
Maya (PR): Timeline summary:
- Mon 09:00 PT: perf freeze (Tom)
- Mon EOD: final quote draft in doc (Maya)
- Tue noon: calendar poll closes (all)
- Wed morning: lock briefing schedule (Ethan)
- Wed EOD: Legal sign-off on quote + boilerplate (Noah)
- Thu: analyst briefings start (confirmed slots)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you see tasks you own.
Ethan (Growth): :thumbsup: I got scheduling.
Lena (Product): :thumbsup: I'll prep slides.
Tom (Engineering): :thumbsup: perf freeze on my calendar.
Noah (Legal): :thumbsup: will review quote Mon.
Sofia (Sales): :thumbsup: will draft playbook by Wed.
Maya (PR): Thanks all — ping here if anything changes. If someone needs to change embargo timing, call it out asap.
